hooks.command: bash -c 'stamp="temp/.dev-guide-remind-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo none)"; s=$(git status --short src/ 2>/dev/null); g=$(git status --short .claude/skills/dev-guide/ 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$s" ] && [ -z "$g" ] && [ ! -f "$stamp" ]; then mkdir -p temp 2>/dev/null; touch "$stamp" 2>/dev/null; echo "[dev-guide] src/ changed but the dev-guide skill did not. If this touched data flow, module interfaces, pitfalls, or a new module, update .claude/skills/dev-guide/modules/0N-*.md per SKILL.md before finishing (remind once per commit)." 1>&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'
